question:

history.name: Computer_terminal
history.content:
exitcode: 0 (execution succeeded)
Code executed:

import pandas as pd
file_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/7bd855d8-463d-4ed5-93ca-5fe35145f733.xlsx"
df = pd.read_excel(file_path)
food_columns = ['Burgers', 'Hot Dogs', 'Salads', 'Fries']  # Excluding Soda and Ice Cream per decision
total_food_sales = df[food_columns].sum().sum()
print(f"Total food sales (excluding Soda and Ice Cream): ${total_food_sales:.2f}")

Output:
